posts.subject: My suggestions for Knife/Mg/Arena
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Admin Team.


I decieded to look for some plugins that could help improve the following servers into better.
Arena:
Rooftop Arena 1v1
Brief description: The fight focuses on top of roof with a few things to cover behind but the map is not huge
Workshop link:
am_dd2_middle 1v1

Brief Description: The fight takes place in a mid of dust 2 where t's start on top mid and ct's on bottom mid
Workshop link:
1v1_Doom

Brief Description: The fight takes place in a doom map where each player spawns in a spearate room, the map is open and seems like there is a bit of space to fight.
Workshop link:
am_inferno 1v1
Brief Description: The fight takes place in a inferno style map with a fountainn in the middle and both enemies spawn on elevated place ( not sure how to call it)


Workshop link:
Zeus round

As the name says it all the players will fight against eachother with a zeus
Plugin link:

Minigames:
Boucing Bomb
Brief description: In this minigame you have to blow up the enemy team by pushing the bomb in their base, when the timer of the team reachs 0, the bomb explodes.
Workshop link:
Mg_mario_course_v1
Brief description: Player can only Join T's and their point is to complete the course map alive.
workshop link:
mg_pauls_teambattle_v3
Brief description: players respawn on a little island together and to choose the played gamemode they have to climb a enterance and they have to climb the ladder
Gammemodes: Kz, Football, Surf, Targets and few more
Workshop link:




Knife:
35hp ( for some reason the map does not have it's name )
Brief description: Players get spawed in 2 separate spawns they can walk to middle which is 3 pipes or walk down a ramp to meet other in middle the map is preatty high so NoFallDamage is suggested 😏
workshop link:
35hp_miecraft_go
Brief description: players spawn on minecraft looking map ( Oh gj Oxy that's obvious in the name 😏 ) and there is a chamber/ room in a middle they can enter but I could not find exit out of ( possible chaos when alot of players )
workshop link:
35hp_aztec
Brief description: Aztec like looking map which has some space but the key points before it get's added are when I tested it on bot's the map has 100hp and gives players glock ( this is possibly because servers have plugins and shiet )
workshop link:

~ I would possibly like to see some Cs 1.6 servers such as deatchmatch or bomb plants or paintball { Something people still play }
 
~Also there are some maps on knife server such as 35hp_Venice where you still keep your nade next map or 35hp_rush_hour where there is a sideways truck which does not fit on the road and goes throught object such as walls but a nice guy @Nachtfrische told us not to go on the road when there is a truck coming ( people did not listen ) 😏


~ Remove flashbang from 35hp_lego_boxing I know there used to be [smoke] to annoy people but now a chaos is the flashbang that is on each side ( x1 ) and players annoy the other fighting in ( possibly change it to a decoy )


~ Credits I would like to see credits be given like stamm points after certain amout of people join to prevent "credits farming" when there is noone on the server


~ Add a possible Stamm event and Credits event for couple of hours on all servers where players would get x10 stamm
x10 = 1 hour event
x9 = 1.1 hour event
x8 = 1.2 hour event
x7 = 1.3 hour event
x5 = 1.5 hour event ( Max for stamm )
etc.


~ Add instat warning when a player tries to write in different langauge in chat than in rules we can ask @Luckiris 😏 ❤️ ❤️ ❤️

#Double Post


Anticamp
Brief Description: prevents players from camping for X amount of Seconds ( specially would be helpful on knife )
Plugin link:
Weapon Jam
Brief Description: There is a probability of your weapon getting jammed which would be cool and maybe "Maybe" could crate minigames or arena more tactical
Plugin link:
Admins see enemy chat
Brief Description: admins will see private team chat so if there is any insulting it's way easier to see as not all insults happen on public chat. ( This can be used on any dream server so it's easier to see people insulting )
Plugin link:
Steam group (MONEY) award
Brief Description: If the player is in Dream steam group they will get awarded money this is specially and would be helpful for players on JAIL but I believe there is a chance to possibly edit it so it works like this for stamm points too.
Plugin link:
Silent Disconnect
Brief Description: It suppresses the disconnect message which can get annoying and distracting in a way when there is ton of players disconnecting, which could help.
Plugin link:
FreeKill report ( Not sure if it's on Jail already)
Brief Description: Let's say a CT freekills someone and when they type !fk they select a ct and it will send the message to online admins
Plugin link:




~ Make knife server 30 slot or more depends if possible as when the knife server is full sometimes it's difficult for admin to connect to handle a calladmin which then leads to chaos.


~ Add to rules that you're not allowed to "Mic abuse" I know it says "No spamming" but players could only think this rule applies to chat.


~ Fix the English translation on forum "Administrators[Bild]" should say " Leader " and "Foren" should be "Forum" ( OxygeN complaining like a little kid 😏 )

~ In the rules it says "english and german" in small letters, I know it's nothing major but it makes the community better in the eyes of kids that complain about such a small thing.
